newsitem.title: USA: Symbol says court dismisses class action.
newsitem.headline: Symbol says court dismisses class action.

text.p: Symbol Technologies Inc said on Thursday that that U.S. District Court judge John Gleason granted the dismissal of a shareholder class action lawsuit which alleged violations of federal securities laws based on statements made by the company in 1992.

The company said the court ruled that plaintiffs could not present sufficient evidence to support a jury verdict in their favor. The statements at issue were not actionable statements under federal securities laws. The court dismissed all of the plaintiffs' claims.
Symbol Technologies designs, manufactures and markets bar code scanning equipment, application-specific hand held computers and radio frequency data communications products and systems.
